title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.33 (quiet) at 07:18 UTC on 19 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 19 日 07:18 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest complete-minute estimated Kp = 0.33 (label 0P). Last-180-sample maximum is 2.67 (at 04:57 UTC); published-window maximum is 2.67 (at 04:57 UTC). Hours through 00:00 UTC have rolled out of the public window. Residual 01:00 UTC slice: peak 2.33 / 2P (38 samples from 01:22, closed at 2.33 / 2P). Completed bins 02:00–06:00 UTC closed at 2.33 / 0.67 / 2.33 / 2.67 / 1.00 respectively (04:00 peak 2.67 / 3M; 05:00 peak 2.67 / 3M; 06:00 peak 1.00 / 1Z). 07:00 UTC bin is in progress (19 samples; peak 1.00 / 1Z, last 0.33 / 0P). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest complete minute (not a lone new-hour 0.00 placeholder). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window (~355 samples), so earlier hours fall out of the file. The in-progress 07:00 UTC hour currently ends at 0.33 / 0P and may be revised as NOAA updates.

title.en: A magnitude 5.2 earthquake occurred 210 km WNW of Abepura, Indonesia on 19 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 19 日，印尼阿貝普拉西北西約 210 公里發生規模 5.2 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 5.2, depth about 10 km (operator assigned). Retained from earlier listing. Current day-feed maximum remains mww 5.5 (us7000tigd).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 5.2，深度約 10 公里（作業員指定）。沿用稍早上架紀錄。一日饋送目前最大仍為 mww 5.5（us7000tigd）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events. Depth is operator assigned.
